about.title: Hello!
about.subtitle: Nazywam się Marcin. Grafiką 3D zawodowo zajmuję się od ponad 17 lat. Specjalizuję się w grafice 3D. Zapraszam do zapoznania się z notką o mnie oraz moim portfolio!

description-more.01: I am a graduate of the University of Information Technology and Management in Rzeszów, where I completed a degree in Computer Graphics and Animation, as well as postgraduate studies in Software Engineering.
description-more.02: I create 3D models with an emphasis on: clean and optimized topology, attention to detail, and proper asset preparation for subsequent production stages. I have experience working with 3D object scanning and 3D printing.
description-more.04: Below is a subjective assessment of my experience and comfort in working with a given software, not a rigid percentage measure - learning in 3D never ends.
description-more.07: Automotive is one of my favorite areas of 3D work, where I can fully utilize my modeling, rigging, animation, and rendering skills.
